articles.summary: Hammond, Louisiana , January 28, 2026 First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. ("First Guaranty") (NASDAQ: FGBI), the holding company for First Guaranty Bank, announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter and year ending December 31, 2025. Financial Highlights for the fourth quarter and year ending December 31, 2025, are as follows: Net income for the fourth quarter of 2025 and 2024 was $2.5 million and $1.0 million, respectively, an increase of $1.5 million.
